name: bob-collision-masks
source:
Make Mask 1
Hot Spot 1,0,0
Bob 0,0,0,1
Bob 1,2,0,1
Print Bob Col(0)
Print Col(1)
Bob 1,3,0,1
Print Bob Col(0)
Print Col(1)

encoding.notes: Hand-specified instruction bytes, independent of TokenTable and the token encoder; Object/Icon bank bytes reuse image-banks.hex. Bob Col=0x1b36, Col=0x1b52, Bob=0x1b9e, Make Mask Image=0x1d38, Hot Spot=0x1da2. Source is a semantic equivalent, not an AMOS export.

evidence.notes: An existing mask is compared at current Bob coordinates on the same screen; no draw/update is required after Make Mask. The independent image mask occupies columns 0..2 on its first row: moving Bob 1 from x=2 to x=3 changes one-pixel contact to transparent bounding-box overlap. A fresh Bob Col query clears previous hits. Expectations remain source-derived pending AMOS execution.
